# `aitbc network lease-status`

Check the current lease status for a subscriber.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc network lease-status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-id` | text | — | no | Subscriber node ID (default: from NODE_ID in /etc/aitbc/node.env) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc network lease-status
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc network lease-status --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
